title: Primary Staining
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload custom labware definition, if needed.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Prepare deck and equipment
steps.instruction: Place an empty waste reservoir, a 12‑channel reagent reservoir, tip racks, and any required Eppendorf plate(s) on the deck, and mount the P300‑Multi‑Channel pipette on the left mount.

steps.title: Download protocol bundle
steps.instruction: Download the protocol bundle from the Opentrons website.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definition
steps.instruction: If needed, upload a custom labware definition for any non‑standard labware you will use.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol into the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange all labware on the robot deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the positions of the labware, tip racks, and the P300‑Multi pipette.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the automated protocol.

steps.title: Iterate staining on each plate
steps.instruction: For each of up to four plates, perform the following liquid‑handling sequence.

substeps.instruction: Remove 120 µL of media from each well.
Add 140 µL of PBS to each well.
Remove 140 µL of PBS from each well.
Add 140 µL of PBS to each well.
Remove 140 µL of PBS from each well.
Add 100 µL of 2 % PFA to each well.
Pause for the required incubation (duration not specified).
Remove 100 µL of 2 % PFA from each well.
Add 140 µL of PBST to each well.
Remove 140 µL of PBST from each well.
Add 140 µL of Blocking Buffer to each well.
Remove 140 µL of Blocking Buffer from each well.
Add 140 µL of Primary Antibody to each well.
